title: create syllabus request
description: JSON body for paste, or the "metadata" part of a multipart upload (then text is absent and the "file" part carries the document; metadata part at most 4 KB). Exactly one of file part / text must be supplied (server test). Idempotency-Key header is required. noticeVersion and attestation are required and stored. Unknown members are rejected by the server. No retention, provider or reminder fields exist by design.

text.description: Pasted text: treated exactly like a file (same canonicalization, limits, retention). NUL is rejected; format/bidi characters are stripped during canonicalization.

attestation.description: Student attestation recorded with the notice version. Wording is a PO/counsel placeholder (P2-D5); the UI must not imply Tether verified permission.
